settings.title: Settings
settings.dynamic-color-desc: Extract a theme color from the cover when opening a work
settings.r18-cover-desc: R-18 cover blur: always blurred / blurred until hover / always clear
settings.time-display-desc: Show total time (22:33) or remaining time (-1:39) in the player
settings.works-pagination-desc: Paged (jump to a page; page number and filters sync to the URL and title) or infinite scroll
settings.paginator-position-desc: Show the library paginator at the top, bottom, or both
settings.recent-listens-desc: Show the recent listens strip at the top of the library home
settings.media-notification-desc: Show playback controls in the system media panel / lock screen
settings.floating-lyrics-desc: Show the current lyrics above the play bar during playback
settings.lines-limit-desc: Wrap long lyrics; overflow is omitted
settings.restore-confirm: This will overwrite current local settings with cloud profile "{{name}}". Restore anyway?
auth.has-account-login: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.setup.no-old-data: No old data detected (old-data directory). You can skip this step; automatic migration will no longer be possible afterwards.
auth.setup.detected-number178: Detected old data from a Number178 fork (kikoeru number17):

auth.setup.stat-play-history_other: {{count}} play history entries (converted to read marks)
auth.setup.migrate-switch-desc: Migrated together when you finish setup; turning this off skips it, and automatic migration will no longer be possible afterwards.
auth.setup.root-folder-hint: After migration, update the rootFolder path in Settings to the actual path of this environment, then run a scan.
auth.setup.mode-desc: Private mode requires sign-in; public mode allows anonymous (read-only) browsing.
auth.setup.register-desc: Whether to allow users to register themselves (registered users get the user role by default; changeable anytime in the backend).
